row.proto: void Game_Place_Vehicle(void *car, const char *tag, int priority, const float *mtx44_a, const float *mtx44_b, float dt, uint32_t flags)
row.notes: Vehicle placement request (teleport): under the request lock (req[0x13]) stores a new placement when its priority param_3 >= the pending one (req+8): name/tag pointer (req+0), priority, 64-byte world matrix param_4 (req+0x10..+0x4f), 64-byte second matrix param_5 (req+0x50..+0x8f), blend time float (req+0x90), flags (req+0x94); lower priority requests are dropped. Leading loop over 0x14604b4f0 only logs (flags&3, blend > 1/30 s, !(flags&0x40)). The vehicle applies it on its next physics step. 10+ callers incl. 0x142d5a086 (session grid placement), Game_PitLane_MoveDownSpline (prio 3). (used by vmknolle race-start, red-flag-pit, sc-unlapping) | car-re: pit lane placement (mode 3 from moveDownSpline); 4x4 matrix, translation at mtx+0x30; same family as Game_Teleport_Vehicle. (used by the vmknolle addons cooldown-lap, pitlane-start, red-flag-pit, sc-unlapping)

verify.notes: V1034 role ok (Car::teleportRequest: VEHICLE_TELEPORT log, priority param_3 vs stored, critical section) but proto differs: p4 and p5 are BOTH 64-byte 4x4 matrices copied to req[2..9] and req[0xc..] (both positions logged), param_6 is a time interval (compared with 1/30 s for velocity linear approximation; MoveDownSpline forwards its dt) not a speed; param_3 is a priority, not a mode

V1069 Car::teleportRequest: under CS (+0x98) keeps highest-priority request this frame (logs Updated/Skipped/more than once), stores tag,prio,2x mat44,dt,flags; 7-arg proto matches; arg0 is the same Car ptr the immediate path gets (name teleport_req is just the request holder)
